name: Pyramids Apt. 6
headline: Jacuzzi 2BDR By The Historic Pyramids (Apt.6)
summary: Welcome to the Pyramids Boutique Apartments The best place to enjoy a great view of the Magical Pyramids Of Giza!!

description.Space:
-This bright apartment features a bright, sparkling clean jacuzzi where guests can chill in warm water after a long day of walking in the busy streets of Giza. 

- The first bed room is a master bedroom with full bathroom and kitchenette.
- The second room is an extra external room with cozy living room, full bathroom and kitchenette.
- Moving from the main room to the extra external room is from a small sharing corridor.
- Fresh, laundered hotel-grade pure Egyptian cotton linen, along with face & body crisp clean towels are provided.
- A small dining table is also available to use. 
- Wi-Fi, Cable TV, & Chrome Cast are also available and free of charge.
- Nespresso machine.
- Complimentary water, juice, & 2 coffee capsules.
- Please note that there is a small sharing corridor between the main and extra external room.
description.Access:
This is an entire apartment, and guests can have access to all of its features. 
For bigger groups, please contact us as additional units might be available.
description.Interaction: We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7.
description.Neighborhood:
A 5 min walk from the Pyramids gate entrance. 
This unit is located in a new building in an authentic very local but also very safe neighbourhood. For this reason, nearby streets are not all yet paved. Guests can expect it to busy (as it is all around Cairo ; ) )
There is a pharmacy, supermarket and a bazaar (gift shop) within 1 min walking distance from this building.

Please note that this apartment is located in a local and modest neighbourhood. Guests staying should expect that the surrounding areas to the building are not of high standards. However, the apartment is highly well maintained and sparkling clean as shown in the photos.
description.Transit:
- Airport pickup / drop off 
We provide pickup and drop off for a competitive rate.
- Tours
We provide unique tours and excursions at very competitive prices.
description.Notes:
Please note that outside visitors are not allowed. Only guests that are included in a reservation and have submitted their proof of identity will be allowed access to the property.
Please note that there is a small sharing corridor between the main and extra external room.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays
